systemStatus.headline: SAT SEP 12 7:15 AM PT REFRESH. ALL FIVE SOURCES CAPTURED -- Toast, Sling, Google Ads (live), Yelp Ads (live), TripAdvisor (no report). THE HEADLINE IS GOOD: FRIDAY WAS THE BEST DAY SINCE THE AUG 22 RECORD. Net $8,221.35 on 175 orders and 295 guests, +87.5% on Thursday, at 25.5% labor -- the heavy 63.75-hour roster paid for itself and then some. (1) GOOGLE ADS: STILL 91% OVER BUDGET, BUT IT FINALLY CONVERTED. $76.47 against a $40/day cap for the third straight day of ~1.9x overspend, but CPC dropped from $4.00 to $2.55, clicks rose to 30, and Brewhouse Dinner logged a conversion (2 this week per Google). Brewhouse Lunch remains the problem: $49.91 for 14 clicks and zero conversions -- 65% of spend, none of the results. Recommendation unchanged in spirit but sharper: pause Brewhouse Lunch, keep Dinner, and take the policy-manager pass ('All ads limited by policy' on both). (2) THURSDAY'S VOIDS ARE NOW QUANTIFIED AND THEY ARE LARGE: the full-detail email shows $827.00 voided across 39 items / 12 orders -- 18% of that day's net, +536% vs same-day-last-week. Friday's closeout had 16 void items, one open order and TWO auto-clock-outs (Julianna Ornelas, Nathan Smith). Three nights running the day has not closed cleanly; worth a word with whoever is closing. (3) TODAY IS STAFFED LIGHTER THAN FRIDAY: 11 employees / 12 shifts / 60 hours vs Friday's 12 / 14 / 63.75, with one cook and no runner, on what is normally the bigger day. (4) YELP: audience size 'Limited' for the third run; performance flat (101 leads at $3.94). September spend $157.45, ~10% ahead of the $13/day pace. CARRIED FORWARD: Google review counts (from the 4 AM run today: 8 unreplied Brewhouse, 2 Coffee, no new reviews), the 52-day-old GBP management request. Yelp inbox still 15 unread (13 days) and 3 reviews needing attention -- badges verified live.

toast.note: Friday Sep 11 net $8,221.35 on gross $8,492.95 -- BEST DAY OF THE WEEK BY A WIDE MARGIN, +87.5% on Thursday's $4,385.27 and the highest net since the Aug 22 record Saturday. 175 orders and 295 guests (Thu: 131 / 177) at a $46.98 average order and $27.87 per guest, both up sharply. LABOR CAME IN AT 25.5% OF NET (~$2,096) -- the heavy 63.75-hour roster was fully absorbed; Thursday's fear of a 30%+ day did not materialise, and 25.5% is the best labor ratio of the week. Discounts 3.2% of gross (~$272), refunds and gift-card deferrals zero. Ten takeout orders for $70.90. CLOSEOUT: 16 void items (down from Thursday's 39 but still elevated vs the 3-4 seen Mon-Wed), one order left open at close, and TWO people auto-clocked out (Julianna Ornelas, Nathan Smith) -- third night running the day has not closed cleanly. SCOPE CAVEAT: group-level headline totals only; SDLW / 4-week comparisons, revenue centres and sales categories fill when the single-location email lands (it has arrived 14:38-14:39Z the last three days).

sling.note: LIVE for today. Sat Sep 12 report received 2026-09-12T14:00Z: 11 scheduled employees across 12 shifts, 60 hours, 0 uncovered, 0 overtime, 0 off. Slightly lighter than Friday (12 / 14 / 63.75) -- one fewer head and 3.75 fewer hours -- for what is normally the busier day. Roster: 1 cook (Isael Salvador Narciso), 2 baristas, 3 bartenders (Andrew Turner, Katharine Brown, Fred De Leon), 5 server shifts, 1 busser. Emily Lanzel doubles barista then server. unanswered.name: Luke Mayer (Cheez boi)
unanswered.text: The coffee was good. The everything bagel was exceptional, perfectly toasted to light crunch on the outside with a soft an chewy interior and a generous topping of melting butter alongside a prodigal portion of cream cheese. The breakfast burrito was simply exquisite, containing the perfect ratio of scrambled egg, bacon, avocado, sour cream, breakfast potato, cheese, and salsa on the side.
unanswered.draftReply: Luke, that may be the most thorough bagel review we have ever received and we are keeping it. Glad the burrito ratio landed right too. Come back hungry.

unanswered.name: Isabel Osmundsen
unanswered.draftReply: Isabel, thank you for the five stars. Next time you are in, tell us what you had so we can make sure it keeps being that good. See you soon.

unanswered.name: Justin Ladner
unanswered.draftReply: Justin, five out of five on food, service and atmosphere is about as good as it gets. Thanks for taking the time to rate us. Hope to see you back on Montecito soon.

unanswered.name: R. Muller
unanswered.text: Always looking for great coffee spots. So good! Kids had some muffins fresh out of the oven. Highly recommend.
unanswered.draftReply: Thank you for the coffee shout out, and glad the kids hit the muffins fresh out of the oven. That is the best window of the day around here. Come see us again.

unanswered.name: sergio salazar
unanswered.text: great food staff was on point very friendly, I highly recommend it and definitely driving 3 hours to go back.
unanswered.draftReply: Sergio, driving three hours to come back is the biggest compliment we get. Glad the staff took good care of you. We will be ready when you make the trip.

unanswered.name: Betty Chambers
unanswered.text: We were looking for a dog friendly restaurant on our way home to san diego. The food was great and our dog loved what you had. The waitress was great.
unanswered.draftReply: Betty, we are glad your dog approved. Thanks for stopping with us on the way to San Diego, and for the kind words about your server. Come back through anytime.

unanswered.name: Donald Clay
unanswered.text: Beer was not good at all. Got botulism from taco. Recovering now. Avoid this place.
unanswered.escalate: ~6 WEEKS PUBLIC AND UNANSWERED. Public foodborne-illness allegation. Do NOT admit or deny in the public reply. Take it offline, notify insurer/counsel, and check whether SB County Public Health has any record before posting anything.
unanswered.draftReply: Donald, we take any report of illness seriously and we want to look into this properly. Please reach us directly at (805) 884-4664 or mojobrewhouse@gmail.com so we can get the details of your visit. -- Joal, owner

unanswered.name: John Rinaldo
unanswered.draftReply: John, a one star with no details leaves us guessing and we would rather know. If something went wrong, email us at mojobrewhouse@gmail.com and we will make it right.
